licence_blocker: Election download pages link the CZSO terms, but their operative scope names csu.gov.cz. Obtain a dataset-specific licence statement or publisher confirmation for the actual volby.gov.cz files. No domain extension is assumed.

reuse_right.basis: ČSÚ terms: 'Statistické informace Českého statistického úřadu zveřejněné prostřednictvím internetových stránek https://csu.gov.cz jsou licencovány v souladu s CC BY 4.0'. The volby.gov.cz open-data index links these terms in its footer, but the operative sentence names csu.gov.cz, not volby.gov.cz.

normalized_republication.basis: Would follow from CC BY 4.0 if the terms cover volby.gov.cz files.

raw_redistribution.basis: CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution only if it applies to these files; not inferred from factual reuse.

automated_acquisition.basis: volby.gov.cz robots.txt disallows only /pls/; CZSO terms contain no crawler clause. Absence of a prohibition is not a permission.

manual_acquisition.basis: Public download pages; no restriction found.

source_files_complete.basis: Exact per-election package inventory complete for 2002–2025 (documentary_review.json); packages not acquired.

national_definition_complete.basis: 2025 vysledky.xml observed 2026-10-02: PROC_HLASU = HLASY / PLATNE_HLASY; UCAST_PROC = VYDANE_OBALKY / ZAPSANI_VOLICI. 2002–2021 data-record definitions (PS_datovaveta) not inspected.

electoral_system_metadata_complete.basis: No dated review of thresholds/allocation per election; 2021 mandate-allocation description (RozdelovaniMandatuPS2021_Popis.pdf) linked but not inspected.

manual_work: VSTRANA identifies electoral contestants, including coalitions, not exclusively registered legal parties. CVS offers comparisons since 1998 but does not prove legal continuity.
CNS.NSTRANA, CPP.PSTRANA, CVS.VSTRANA and election ballot KSTRANA are distinct concepts.
Historical ČSSD/SOCDEM and 2025 ČSSD – Česká suverenita sociální demokracie must not be joined by name.
2021 and 2025 coalitions require election-specific registered composition; votes are never allocated to member parties.
Exact dated electoral law review and final national totals/seat/turnout verification remain required after a lawful source acquisition route is confirmed.

notes: 2017 official index distinguishes original and court-recalculated results published 2017-11-22. Preserve both; a future production definition must select its vintage explicitly.
2002–2013 pages now link retrospective 2023 XML/CSVW packages, not the live XML endpoint pattern for recent elections.
2025 XML documentation introduces postal-envelope fields and four foreign reporting areas. No double counting of overseas votes.
